{{< include _setup.qmd >}}

```{python}
status = data.plugin_status()
now = status[status["month"] == status["month"].max()].set_index("state")["plugins"]
total = int(now.sum())
recent = int(now[data.PLUGIN_STATES["recent"]])
living_share = status["recent_share_of_living"].iloc[-1]
c = data.contributors_by_year()
year = int(c["year"].max())
contributors = int(c.loc[c["year"] == year, "contributors"].sum())
new = int(c.loc[(c["year"] == year) & (c["kind"] == "New"), "contributors"].sum())
d = data.pypi_downloads().tail(12)["downloads"].sum()
```

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### `{python} f"{total:,}"` plugins
released on PyPI, `{python} f"{recent:,}"` with a release in the last six months
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### `{python} f"{contributors:,}"` contributors
to public napari repos in `{python} year` so far, `{python} new` of them new
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### `{python} f"{d / 1e6:.1f}"` M downloads
of napari from PyPI in the last twelve months
:::
